issues.title: Future goal — private guitar practice studio, mastering and explainable feedback
issues.description:
Queued future goal requested by the operator on October 6. The active ten-hour delivery goal TIN-5495 continues unchanged.

Deliver a private clip → processing → matched comparison → source-timed annotation → iteration → download workflow over shared CLI/MCP/web capabilities. Improve perceived low-end fullness and thin/nasal balance through separately versioned tone, dynamics and delivery stages. Default shareable overlays are compact section/phrase labels, BPM and brief issue badges; user assertions remain distinct from detector hypotheses.

Planning envelope: proposed 35-hour core reallocation, then choose ONE optional 35-hour extension: web workflow OR deeper local tone/classification. Existing next-week commitments are not silently replaced. No activation date, hosting promise, model-accuracy SLA or AU acceptance is implied.

Designs: docs/spec/future/GOAL_WEB_PRACTICE_STUDIO.md, MILESTONES.md and README.md in Jesssullivan/video-utils. Six additional GPT-6.1 Sol design lanes plus planning and independent review contributed. Architecture spike will compare SvelteKit control + workers with SvelteKit BFF + FastAPI before choosing a second server layer.

Acceptance: real source-bound local walkthrough; typed controls with discoverable units/defaults/bounds; meaningful property tests and heldout labels; audible comparison accepted by the operator; explicit measured SLO denominators; durable job/recovery proof before hosted claims. Native editor import, staff transcription and Logic remain separate milestones.

accepted_audio_comment_readback.body:
Operator listening QA accepted FULLER-v1 in QuickTime: “sounds excellent!  great work!” Exact accepted candidate: artifacts/runs/20261006T041633Z-990aa1bd6737; durable acceptance docs/agent-notes/2026-10-06-fuller-listening-acceptance.json. This acceptance applies to that audio, not the alternative denoisers or musical classifiers.

Independent saved-artifact audit passed: 44.1 kHz mono, 6,657,385 native samples; pure denoise/residue exactly match NR8; changed EQ is isolated; source picture clocks/payload and protected hashes are preserved. AAC measures −18.01 LUFS / −1.76 dBTP. Measured normalization tradeoffs remain documented alongside the listening decision.

The compact arrangement preview is rendering. Final presentation assembly will stream-copy the approved FULLER audio with the compact marked picture, explicitly retaining the NR10 analysis/marker branch and common original-source identity. No final assembled-video completion is claimed yet. All 29 local tool skills and exact MCP prompts passed readback; consolidated source checks are running. Original deadline and current In Review status remain unchanged.

scope: Independent readback of all 13 goal/scope issues, 7 milestones and accepted-audio comment; no future work activated.
